title: CRS and PJs conduct search and rescue rehersals in Djibouti
description: U.S. Airmen assigned to the 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron, deployed in support of Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa, and U.S. Sailors assigned to Coastal Riverine Squadron 11, deployed in support of Camp Lemonnier, conduct a search and rescue exercise in the Gulf of Aden, Djibouti, May 11, 2019. (U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. Amy Picard)
